lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Does anybody else know about this besides you and Steven?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So I think somebody else does. Who else knows about this?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You told some people. Who did you tell?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: We, we believe you told Travis.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I didn’t talk to him much.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: The last time I talked to’em was or the first time I talked to ‘em before my birthday or after my birthday was on December 25th when we were over by his house for Christmas.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. We heard you were crying a lot. Is that true? It’s OK. If you were, it’s OK. I understand that.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why were you crying a lot?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz after a while I was thinking that I did the wrong thing.
